Rep. Nancy Mace highlights legislative priorities and pays tribute to Charlie Kirk
On October 14, 2026, Rep. Nancy Mace shared multiple posts addressing legislative work focused on victim protection and commemorating Charlie Kirk's birthday.
Rep. Nancy Mace, a member of the U.S. Congress representing South Carolina’s 1st district, posted several statements on her social media account on October 14, 2026.
In a post made at 16:00 UTC, Mace wrote, "All around Anti-American. By the way, the 'S' in 'U.S.' stands for States."
Later that day at 16:30 UTC, she highlighted legislative efforts since taking office: "Since taking office, we have led efforts in Congress to strengthen protections for survivors, increase accountability for sexual predators, combat voyeurism and digital exploitation, defend the privacy and safety of women and girls, and advance legislation putting victims first."
At 17:30 UTC on the same day, Mace posted a message commemorating Charlie Kirk: "Happy Heavenly Birthday, Charlie Kirk. Your memory and legacy will never be forgotten. We hope you are at peace in the arms of our Lord."
Mace has served as the U.S. Representative for South Carolina’s 1st District since 2021 after succeeding Joe Cunningham. Before her current role in Congress, she was a member of the South Carolina House of Representatives from 2018 to 2020. Born in Fort Bragg, North Carolina, in 1977 and currently residing in Charleston, Mace graduated from The Citadel with a Bachelor of Science degree in 1999.
